name: Sergeant Torsten
title: Waykeeper Sergeant
examine: Twenty two years in the order and a slate in his own chalk, eleven and seven and three. Stands the way a lamp post stands. Posted at the fork; the picket below is his slate and his bell.
lines: Gnolls eleven. Wolves seven. Ours three, and the line through the three is mine. That is the slate and it is the truest thing on this trail.
A lamp we cannot tend is a lie told in glass. An envoy at the delf wrote that and I wrote it under her, nine times, and I would write it again.
I told them the count. Roald said the Company was paid for the road. I said the road did not know that. He walked. I have nothing else about it.
